options.text: I am looking for a job

steps.questionText:
Candidate Services

Please select an option:

1. Register as a candidate
2. Submit or update my CV
3. View current vacancies
4. Speak to a recruiter
0. Back to the main menu
Please enter your full name as shown on your CV.

Please enter your current city and country.

Example: Colombo, Sri Lanka

What job role or designation are you currently interested in?

Example: Finance Executive, Software Engineer, Sales Manager

How many years of relevant work experience do you have?

Example: 3 years

Please send your CV as a document or paste your LinkedIn profile link.

You can also email your CV to cv@intalent.asia and mention the relevant job title in the email subject line.

Thank you for registering with InTalent Asia. ✅

Your information has been received successfully. Our recruitment team will review your profile and contact you when a suitable opportunity is available.

Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Current vacancies:
https://intalent.asia/current-vacancies/

Type ‘menu’ whenever you need to return to the main menu.

Employer Services

Please select an option:

1. Request recruitment support
2. Share a job requirement
3. Speak to a recruitment consultant
0. Back to the main menu

Please enter your name and designation.

Example: Kasun Perera – HR Manager

Please briefly describe your hiring requirement.

You may include the job title, number of vacancies, preferred location, required experience and expected hiring timeline.

Thank you. Your hiring requirement has been received successfully.

A member of the InTalent Asia team will review your requirement and contact you as soon as possible.

You can view and apply for current vacancies through:

https://intalent.asia/current-vacancies/
